The study you linked, while showing promising results and giving hope (pretty much confirming what the Chinese doctors already told us), is an observational study not a randomized controlled trial (the kind of studies the doctor of the video is talking about), or the kind of study that will actually, scientifically, prove that the medicines are actually working and are safe (we know that Hydroxychloroquine is normally safe, but it might not be safe for patients with COVID-19 or used together with other medicines... for instance, both Hydroxychloroquine and Azithromycin can substantially change how your heart beats and their effect can add up making it fatal or quite dangerous to some patients).

Medicines are quite complex beasts and this is why a safety and effectiveness study can normally take up years or even decades. For instance, normally a vaccine takes one or two decades before it is declared safe and effective for human use.

You can find more informations about observational studies in contrast with randomized controlled trials here:

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Observational_study
